title: Can I Vibecode It? turns SaaS replacement into a viral public catalogue
summary: The open-source project grades whether coding agents can recreate paid SaaS products and publishes the prompts and trade-offs. Its creator reported 60,000 page views from 15,000 visitors in its first 72 hours; on 19 August, the site listed 1,093 apps while GitHub showed 247 stars, 173 forks and an active contribution queue.

title: Cursor connects coding agents to Google Workspace
summary: Cursor released plugins for Gmail, Google Drive and Google Calendar, allowing its agents to retrieve workspace context and carry out supported mail, file and scheduling actions.

title: Bolt adds a security audit before publishing
summary: Bolt introduced a publish-time review that searches generated applications for security problems and can propose hardening changes before release.

title: Bolt launches reusable Skills
summary: Bolt Skills package reusable context, rules and actions at project or workspace scope, giving teams a durable way to guide repeated agent work.

title: Figma acquires the team behind Bud, formerly Orchids
summary: Figma acquired the team behind the vibe-coding and agent platform Bud, previously called Orchids. The service announced a shutdown while the team moved to Figma.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5 for coding and agents
summary: Anthropic released Sonnet 5 across Claude plans, Claude Code and its API, positioning it as a more capable agentic Sonnet for planning, tool use and coding.

title: Base44 starts rolling out its own app-building model
summary: Wix announced Base 1, a proprietary model specialized for Base44's natural-language application-building workflow, one year after Base44 joined Wix.

title: Crewdle AI finishes third on Product Hunt
summary: Crewdle AI launched as a combined chat, agent, automation, content and website-building platform and ranked number three for the day on Product Hunt.

title: Skybridge ranks second on Product Hunt launch day
summary: The open-source React framework for MCP apps ranked number two for the day and number five for the week, reflecting growing interest in interactive applications that run inside AI assistants.

title: Google AI Studio expands into full-stack vibe coding
summary: Google upgraded AI Studio with its Antigravity coding agent and Firebase integrations for building applications with databases, multiplayer features and connections to external services.
